WITH members_with_major AS (
  SELECT link_to_major
  FROM member
  WHERE link_to_major IS NOT NULL
),
group_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    link_to_major,
    COUNT(*) as member_count
  FROM members_with_major
  GROUP BY link_to_major
),
total_count AS (
  SELECT CAST(SUM(member_count) AS FLOAT) as total
  FROM group_counts
),
shares AS (
  SELECT 
    gc.member_count,
    CAST(gc.member_count AS FLOAT) / tc.total as share
  FROM group_counts gc
  CROSS JOIN total_count tc
),
average_share_value AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share
  FROM shares
),
filtered_groups AS (
  SELECT 
    s.member_count,
    s.share,
    asv.avg_share
  FROM shares s
  CROSS JOIN average_share_value asv
  WHERE s.share > asv.avg_share
)
SELECT 
  SUM(member_count) as total_members,
  AVG(share) as average_of_shares,
  AVG(share - avg_share) as average_excess
FROM filtered_groups;

assumptions.assumption: Groups whose share is above the average share are filtered using > (strictly greater than), not >= (greater than or equal to), per the standard meaning of 'above'.
